mapper.sql: a.id::text AS id, a.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, a.session_id, a.name, a.input_path, a.size, a.sha256
mapper.select: SELECT , b.content, a.created_at, a.expires_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments a JOIN nw_chat_attachment_bodies b ON b.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND b.sha256=a.sha256 AND b.size=a.size AND b.format=a.body_format WHERE a.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND a.session_id=#{session} AND a.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()

SELECT , NULL::bytea AS content, created_at, expires_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments a WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()

SELECT , NULL::bytea AS content, created_at, expires_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments a WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT , NULL::bytea AS content, created_at, expires_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments a WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()
AND id IN
CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
AND FALSE
mapper.update: WITH expired AS ( SELECT id FROM nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND body_format IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE nw_chat_session_attachments attachment SET body_format=NULL,reclaimed_at=clock_timestamp(),name=NULL FROM expired WHERE attachment.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND attachment.id=expired.id
